reason: The named lab and the report on the product page answer my first question, and the empty-box guarantee means I am not stuck with another half-used bottle in the drawer. At $24.99 it is an easy impulse buy if a creator shows a sleep or stress problem I have.
objection: Anyone can put a QR code on a box. I would want to open the report and see it is for the real batch, not a generic one. And I have been burned by bottles I stopped taking after a week.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report did not open, or was not for a specific batch, I would pass.
